mutations.name: the sent-back allowlist lacks waive-proof
kills: a sent-back gate's waive-proof tap taps a waivable sh-sent-back gate with await-new-head and offers waive-proof as its second tap, never abandon

mutations.name: an item with no options is offered every decision
kills: a sent-back gate's waive-proof tap offers no waiver on a sent-back gate whose item lists no options, leaving that check to the factory

mutations.name: a second tap is offered where the gate lacks the item's own
kills: a sent-back gate's waive-proof tap offers no waiver alone on a sent-back gate whose options lack await-new-head
